full_details: At the Cross Keys in the morning you rehearsed Egeon. Kemp's tally stayed at twenty-four lines, with nothing added and no song. At home the Sunday letter was still the Sunday letter, folded for the carrier. At two you opened The Comedy of Errors again. After the play you went to the Bell. Gilbert was in the yard about the horses and left before you opened the sheet. You paid Hobbins twopence. The groats had come nine days late and been spent inside the hour. Judith sings a ballad at the wash that she could not read. Hamnet bought a whistle and lent the odd penny. Your father's cough is gone. Of your coming, Anne wrote that she will believe the horse when she hears it. You laughed without sound. Hobbins asked if it was good news. You said it was just news, and rarer. A sentence in a different ink, about your father and a whittawer, you read quickly and put away. At the lodging a joiner's man, sent by Mistress Ansell, took a wedge of three foul leaves out from under the stool. She paid him threepence. The stool stands level on Anne's cushion. You kept the wedge.
one_sentence: Hobbins brought Anne's letter and took the Sunday sheet, and at home three cut leaves came out from under the stool.
title: Anne's letter was just news
